# National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)

> NIST develops and maintains measurement standards, reference materials, and research to advance U.S. innovation, security, and competitiveness across critical technologies and industries.

NIST is a federal agency that provides essential standards, calibration services, and scientific research across diverse fields including artificial intelligence, quantum computing, bioscience, and critical infrastructure. The organization operates multiple laboratories and maintains extensive databases of Standard Reference Materials and Data used by industry and government worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Standard Reference Materials (SRM)
- Standard Reference Data
- Measurement Standards
- Artificial Intelligence Governance
- Quantum Computing
- Semiconductor Technology
- Critical Infrastructure
- Construction Safety
- Fire Research
- Biopharmaceuticals
- Medical Devices
- Calibration Services
- NIST Research
- NextG Communications
- Smart Cities

## Advanced Technologies & Computing

- [Artificial Intelligence](https://www.nist.gov/artificial-intelligence): NIST AI governance, risk management framework and standards
- [Electronics](https://www.nist.gov/electronics): NIST electronics standards, semiconductor and quantum computing research
- [Advanced Communications](https://www.nist.gov/advanced-communications): NIST advanced communications research for 5G, NextG and spectrum

## Infrastructure & Safety

- [Infrastructure](https://www.nist.gov/infrastructure): NIST critical infrastructure, smart cities and community resilience research
- [Buildings & Construction](https://www.nist.gov/buildings-construction): NIST building codes, construction safety and disaster prevention
- [Fire](https://www.nist.gov/fire): NIST fire research, safety testing and wildfire prevention methods

## Measurement Science & Standards

- [Chemistry](https://www.nist.gov/chemistry): NIST chemistry standards, measurement methods and reference databases
- [Energy](https://www.nist.gov/energy): NIST energy measurement science, testing methods and efficiency standards
- [Environment](https://www.nist.gov/environment): NIST environmental science measurements and climate monitoring tools

## Life Sciences & Health

- [Bioscience](https://www.nist.gov/bioscience): NIST bioscience research including genome editing and biopharmaceuticals
- [Health](https://www.nist.gov/health): NIST medical device standards, clinical diagnostics and biotherapeutics
- [Forensic Science](https://www.nist.gov/forensic-science): NIST forensic science standards and criminal justice research programs

## Products & Services

- [Shop NIST](https://shop.nist.gov): NIST e-commerce store for Standard Reference Materials and Data

## Support & Contact

- [Contacting NIST](https://www.nist.gov/contact): Staff directory and contact information for NIST locations
